title: TRUCK FISHING
prompt: Create an original finished TRANSPARENT title logo for a 1998–2002 PS1/PS2 mascot arcade sports game. Required reference style: CHUNKY WOBBLY UNEVEN custom hand-lettering, strong sculpted angular bevels painted in THREE broad color planes, thick blue-black outline plus ivory keyline, low-poly faceted toy semi trucks with enormous wheels. Invent a distinct composition. NO realistic materials, no photographic detail, no shiny modern mobile logo, no fine noise. Crisp HD illustration, not pixel art. No panel/background scene, genuine alpha, ample clear margins. All exact words legible and unobscured. EXACT title: "TRUCK FISHING". Composition: Aqua and amber playful curvy letters, huge grinning polygon fish wrapping tail around G without hiding it, rod curving ABOVE title and hook at left, tiny semi cab on a fishing dock below first word. Simple bold water ripple.
